text: [108] 18 aṭṭhahi bhikkhave ākārehi puriso itthiṃ bandhati . katamehi aṭṭhahi rūpena 4 bhikkhave puriso itthiṃ bandhati hasitena bhikkhave puriso itthiṃ bandhati bhaṇitena bhikkhave puriso itthiṃ bandhati gītena 5 bhikkhave puriso itthiṃ bandhati roṇṇena 6 bhikkhave puriso itthiṃ bandhati ākappena 7 bhikkhave puriso itthiṃ bandhati vanabhaṅgena 8 bhikkhave puriso itthiṃ bandhati phassena bhikkhave puriso itthiṃ bandhati . imehi kho bhikkhave aṭṭhahākārehi puriso itthiṃ bandhati tehi 1 bhikkhave sattā subandhāyeva 2 pāsena 3 bandhāti .
